text: You see a battered man.
source_text: You see a battered man.

text: 你看见一个被狂扁过的男人。
source_text: 你看见一个被狂扁过的男人。

text: Thank you stranger! I don't know how many weeks, perhaps months, those thugs have# had me here. I'm very grateful for your help, and I'm sure the Brotherhood of Steel is also.
source_text:
Thank you stranger! I don't know how many weeks, perhaps months, those thugs have
# had me here. I'm very grateful for your help, and I'm sure the Brotherhood of Steel is also.

text: 谢谢你陌生人！我已经不知道过了几个礼拜了，大概有一个月了，那些恶棍一直在囚禁我。对你的帮助我感激不尽，钢铁兄弟会也会同样感激你的。
source_text: 谢谢你陌生人！我已经不知道过了几个礼拜了，大概有一个月了，那些恶棍一直在囚禁我。对你的帮助我感激不尽，钢铁兄弟会也会同样感激你的。

text: Brotherhood of Steel?
source_text: Brotherhood of Steel?

text: 钢铁兄弟会？
source_text: 钢铁兄弟会？

text: Well, I'm glad that I could help.
source_text: Well, I'm glad that I could help.

text: 没关系，我很高兴我能帮上忙。
source_text: 没关系，我很高兴我能帮上忙。

text: Are you going to be okay?
source_text: Are you going to be okay?

text: 你还好吗？
source_text: 你还好吗？

text: I'm from the Brotherhood. I've been looking for you.
source_text: I'm from the Brotherhood. I've been looking for you.

text: 我来自钢铁兄弟会。我一直在找你。
source_text: 我来自钢铁兄弟会。我一直在找你。

text: You're welcome. Bye.
source_text: You're welcome. Bye.

text: 不客气，再见。
source_text: 不客气，再见。

text: Uh.
source_text: Uh.

text: 哦。
source_text: 哦。

text: You haven't heard of us? I'm really surprised. You must not leave the Hub very often. You# should get out more. We're northwest of here, on the west side of the mountain range.
source_text:
You haven't heard of us? I'm really surprised. You must not leave the Hub very often. You
# should get out more. We're northwest of here, on the west side of the mountain range.

text: 你没有听说过我们？我真的感到很惊讶。你不能一直呆在哈勃城。你应该到处走走。我们在哈勃城的西南方向，西边的山脉上。
source_text: 你没有听说过我们？我真的感到很惊讶。你不能一直呆在哈勃城。你应该到处走走。我们在哈勃城的西南方向，西边的山脉上。

text: I really appreciate you helping me, but why are you trying to lie to me? Do you not think# I know every member of our order?
source_text:
I really appreciate you helping me, but why are you trying to lie to me? Do you not think
# I know every member of our order?

text: 我对你的帮助心存感激，但你不该骗我，你应该想到组织里的每个人我都认识。
source_text: 我对你的帮助心存感激，但你不该骗我，你应该想到组织里的每个人我都认识。

text: Talus sent me.
source_text: Talus sent me.

text: 塔鲁斯派我来的。
source_text: 塔鲁斯派我来的。

text: Well, you don't know me, because I just joined.
source_text: Well, you don't know me, because I just joined.

text: 嗯，你之所以不认识我，是因为我刚刚加入钢铁兄弟会。
source_text: 嗯，你之所以不认识我，是因为我刚刚加入钢铁兄弟会。

text: You obviously don't know what you're talking about.
source_text: You obviously don't know what you're talking about.

text: 你明显不知道你自己在说什么。
source_text: 你明显不知道你自己在说什么。

text: Thanks again! If you stop by the Brotherhood, I'd appreciate it if you could let Talus know I'm# okay. I'm sure he's worried. Bye, and take care.
source_text:
Thanks again! If you stop by the Brotherhood, I'd appreciate it if you could let Talus know I'm
# okay. I'm sure he's worried. Bye, and take care.

text: 再次谢谢你！如果你到了钢铁兄弟会，请告诉塔鲁斯我现在很好。我知道他很担心。再见，路上小心。
source_text: 再次谢谢你！如果你到了钢铁兄弟会，请告诉塔鲁斯我现在很好。我知道他很担心。再见，路上小心。

text: Oh, I'll be fine now, thanks. I have some friends here that I can stay with while I regain my strength. I'll try to send word to the Brotherhood to let them know that I am safe now, thanks to you. Bye
source_text: Oh, I'll be fine now, thanks. I have some friends here that I can stay with while I regain my strength. I'll try to send word to the Brotherhood to let them know that I am safe now, thanks to you. Bye

text: 哦，我会好起来的，谢谢。我有一些朋友在这里，他们可以照顾我直到我完全恢复。我会试着捎口信到兄弟会告诉他们我现在很安全，谢谢你，再见。
source_text: 哦，我会好起来的，谢谢。我有一些朋友在这里，他们可以照顾我直到我完全恢复。我会试着捎口信到兄弟会告诉他们我现在很安全，谢谢你，再见。

text: How?Oh, I'm sorry. You must have passed that "test" the Elders made up. I completely forgot# about that. Well, my thanks goes even deeper. I'm glad you never gave up. My life could have been in jeopardy at any moment. It must have taken you a while to hunt me down. This city is huge. The obstacles you must have overcome.
source_text:
How?Oh, I'm sorry. You must have passed that "test" the Elders made up. I completely forgot
# about that. Well, my thanks goes even deeper. I'm glad you never gave up. My life could have been in jeopardy at any moment. It must have taken you a while to hunt me down. This city is huge. The obstacles you must have overcome.

text: 什么？哦，对不起。你应该通过了元老的“测试”。我都忘了。好吧，非常感谢你。很高兴你一直坚持不懈。我总是处在危险中。再迟一会我就会被他们打死。这个地方很大。你要处处小心。
source_text: 什么？哦，对不起。你应该通过了元老的“测试”。我都忘了。好吧，非常感谢你。很高兴你一直坚持不懈。我总是处在危险中。再迟一会我就会被他们打死。这个地方很大。你要处处小心。

text: Well, you know?I'm just that good.
source_text: Well, you know?I'm just that good.

text: 嗯，你知道吗？我那仅仅是运气好。
source_text: 嗯，你知道吗？我那仅仅是运气好。

text: Actually, it was quite easy. Talus knew where you went.
source_text: Actually, it was quite easy. Talus knew where you went.

text: 实际上这很容易。塔鲁斯知道你去什么地方了。
source_text: 实际上这很容易。塔鲁斯知道你去什么地方了。

text: Just lucky I guess.
source_text: Just lucky I guess.

text: 我猜仅仅是运气好而已。
source_text: 我猜仅仅是运气好而已。

text: Well, you're welcome. I'm just glad I found you.
source_text: Well, you're welcome. I'm just glad I found you.

text: 不用谢，我很高兴能找到你。
source_text: 不用谢，我很高兴能找到你。

text: Oh?Well, I'm still very grateful.
source_text: Oh?Well, I'm still very grateful.

text: 哦？好吧，我仍然很感谢你。
source_text: 哦？好吧，我仍然很感谢你。

text: I guess so. that was some fine handy work you did.
source_text: I guess so. that was some fine handy work you did.

text: 我想那对你来说是举手之劳。

text: Well, thanks again. I am going to stay with some friend of mine until I regain my strength. By the# way, I'd watch it around here. I heard my hosts talking about some Thieves' Circle. I guess we're close to# their territory or something. I think that might be why they were talking about moving to a different# location. Bye.
source_text:
Well, thanks again. I am going to stay with some friend of mine until I regain my strength. By the
# way, I'd watch it around here. I heard my hosts talking about some Thieves' Circle. I guess we're close to
# their territory or something. I think that might be why they were talking about moving to a different
# location. Bye.

text: 很好，再次感谢你。我要到我朋友那里休养一段时间，直到我恢复健康。顺便说一下，我以前在这里听人说过小偷公会。我猜我们离他们的地盘太近了。他们可能正在商量要搬到其它地方。再见。

text: 很好，我很高兴你能救我出去。我听说旧城区发生了一些不好的事情。那些人鬼鬼祟祟的，我想一定有什么事情发生。
source_text: 很好，我很高兴你能救我出去。我听说旧城区发生了一些不好的事情。那些人鬼鬼祟祟的，我想一定有什么事情发生。

text: Whatever you say. I'm just grateful to be free again. I don't take well to torture.
source_text: Whatever you say. I'm just grateful to be free again. I don't take well to torture.
